name: Monkilla
summary:
Welcome to Monkilla!
Get ready for a wild adventure inspired by the hit game Gorilla Tag! In Monkilla, movement is everything — swing, jump, climb and zipline using just your hands and controllers. No need for walking locomotion just your controllers!

🌲 Explore Diverse Maps
Traverse the vast and exciting environments!

Forest: Hang around the gazebo and make some friends while having a blast at tag!

City: Explore our various displays of cosmetic. it may not be much but we are expanding this bute as is!
